Precision screwdrivers, ideal for working with small screw slots. Bi-material soft-grip handles designed for comfort, control and to reduce hand strains over long use. Offers higher torque to drive screws effectively. Precision-ground, hardened tool-grade chrome molybdenum blades for extra strength and durability.
